sections.heading: C — Speed control and parking restrictions
sections.markdown:
## C — Speed control and parking restrictions

FACT_ID: sec07-F01 | anchor: A01
Every motor-vehicle driver must comply with the applicable speed limits. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec07-F02 | anchor: A01
The speed at which a vehicle travels affects the driver’s control of it. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec07-F03 | anchor: A01
The handbook lists fifteen miles per hour as the maximum in a school zone with a posted speed limit. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec07-F04 | anchor: A01
For a business or residential area, the handbook gives a thirty-mile-per-hour maximum unless a sign sets a different limit. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec07-F05 | anchor: A01
For public highways, the handbook gives a fifty-five-mile-per-hour maximum unless another limit is posted. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec07-F06 | anchor: A01
For rural interstate highways, the handbook gives a seventy-five-mile-per-hour maximum unless signs state otherwise. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec07-F07 | anchor: A01
Do not drive below a posted minimum speed. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec07-F08 | anchor: A01
When no minimum speed is posted, choose a speed that does not obstruct normal traffic flow. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec07-F09 | anchor: A02
Adjust speed for adverse conditions, the type of vehicle and the need to prevent a crash. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-F10 | anchor: A02
The driver is responsible for ensuring a parked vehicle creates no hazard. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-F11 | anchor: A02
Choose a parking position far enough from moving lanes to avoid interfering with traffic. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-F12 | anchor: A02
A parked vehicle should be visible to drivers approaching from either direction. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-F13 | anchor: A02
Use a designated parking area whenever possible. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-F14 | anchor: A02
Apply the parking brake whenever you park. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-F15 | anchor: A02
Leave a parked manual-transmission vehicle in gear. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-F16 | anchor: A02
Leave a parked automatic-transmission vehicle with the selector in Park. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-F17 | anchor: A02
Check nearby traffic before opening a vehicle door. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-F18 | anchor: A02
If possible, get out of a parked vehicle on the curb side. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-F19 | anchor: A02
When you must exit on the street side, check traffic before getting out. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-F20 | anchor: A02
Close the vehicle door promptly after you get out. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-F21 | anchor: A02
Do not leave ignition keys inside a parked vehicle. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-F22 | anchor: A02
The handbook recommends locking the doors when leaving the vehicle. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-F23 | anchor: A02
If parking on a roadway is necessary, position the vehicle as far from moving traffic as possible. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-F24 | anchor: A02
If you must park on a roadway with a curb, position the vehicle as near to the curb as possible. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-F25 | anchor: A02
The staged handbook directs a driver parking on a hill to turn the wheels sharply toward the road edge or curb. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

Misconceptions: a listed maximum does not replace the need to reduce speed for adverse conditions.
Mnemonics: brake, secure the transmission, then check the door path.
Glossary: a minimum speed is the lower posted limit; standing and parking can both be restricted by a curb marking.
Dynamic facts: actual speed signs and parking controls govern the location; legal thresholds and the points system await currency review.

sections.heading: C2 — Speed control and parking restrictions
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Speed control and parking restrictions

FACT_ID: sec07-R01 | anchor: A02
Parking inside an intersection is prohibited. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R02 | anchor: A02
Parking on a crosswalk or on a sidewalk is prohibited. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R03 | anchor: A02
Do not park in a construction zone when the vehicle would block traffic. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R04 | anchor: A02
The handbook prohibits parking within thirty feet of a traffic signal, stop sign or yield sign. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R05 | anchor: A02
The handbook prohibits parking within twenty-five feet of an intersection crosswalk. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R06 | anchor: A02
Keep parked vehicles at least fifteen feet from a fire hydrant. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R07 | anchor: A02
The handbook prohibits parking within fifty feet of a railroad crossing. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R08 | anchor: A02
A parked vehicle may not be more than eighteen inches from the curb. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R09 | anchor: A02
Do not park within twenty feet of a fire-station driveway on your side of the street. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R10 | anchor: A02
Do not park within seventy-five feet of a fire-station driveway across the street. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R11 | anchor: A02
Do not block a driveway, alley, private road or a lowered curb that provides sidewalk access. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R12 | anchor: A02
Parking on a bridge or overpass, or in a tunnel or underpass, is prohibited. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R13 | anchor: A02
Parking on the wrong side of a street is prohibited. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R14 | anchor: A02
A marked disability parking space requires an authorizing disability plate, tag or sticker. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R15 | anchor: A02
Do not double-park on the traffic-facing side of a vehicle already parked along the road. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R16 | anchor: A02
Parking on railroad tracks is prohibited. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R17 | anchor: A03
Do not park where a sign prohibits parking. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R18 | anchor: A03
A white-painted curb permits brief stops only. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R19 | anchor: A03
A yellow-painted curb identifies loading or another specified restriction. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R20 | anchor: A03
A red-painted curb marks a fire zone where neither parking nor standing is allowed. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R21 | anchor: A03
A blue-painted curb identifies parking reserved for people with disabilities. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R22 | anchor: A03
Common traffic violations can add points, with the number depending on the particular violation. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R23 | anchor: A03
The handbook says accumulating twelve or more points in a twelve-month span produces a one-year driver-license suspension. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R24 | anchor: A03
A list of point-bearing traffic offenses is available from the Motor Vehicle Division. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R25 | anchor: A03
The handbook says driving without insurance requires a court appearance rather than traffic points. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R26 | anchor: A03
The handbook says driving without vehicle registration requires a court appearance rather than traffic points. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R27 | anchor: A03
A court appearance for driving without insurance or vehicle registration can lead to added fines or a suspended license. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R28 | anchor: A01
Drivers moving more slowly than other traffic should travel on the road’s right-hand side. [A02] [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]
